rationale.description: Not in buildings of building classes 1 and 2
Not connecting a maximum of two storeys within the same usage unit with a total gross floor area of no more than 200 m², if a different escape route can be reached on each storey
rationale.code: Not(test.connects.exactly(2, test.Storey & test.isConnectedTo.some(test.EscapeRoute) & test.in.exactly(1, test.UsageUnit & test.totalGrossFloorArea.some(ConstrainedDatatype(float, max_inclusive = 200.0)))))

requirement.description: Must be located in a separate stairwell
